item.title: Indianapolis police union leader pushes for bail restriction amendment
item.description: The leader of the Indianapolis Fraternal Order of Police is advocating for a change to the state constitution to restrict access to bail, citing recent high-profile attacks on officers as justification. The ACLU of Indiana opposes the amendment due to its vague language and potential to contribute to mass incarceration. Indiana voters will consider the amendment during the November general election.

item.title: Proposal advances for data center in Marion County’s Decatur Township
item.description: The Metropolitan Development Commission has approved a zoning variance petition for a 1 million-square-foot, 250-megawatt data center project in Marion County's Decatur Township, despite opposition from local residents citing environmental and public health concerns.

item.title: Airstrikes hit Kabul, hours after Afghanistan attacks Pakistan
item.description: Pakistan and Afghanistan have exchanged airstrikes, with Pakistan claiming to have killed 133 Afghan Taliban fighters and Afghanistan claiming to have killed 55 Pakistani soldiers. It's a significant escalation of violence between the two countries.

item.title: South Korean company to build first US manufacturing facility in Huntington
item.description: Hanjung America will establish its first U.S. manufacturing facility in Huntington, Indiana, initially creating over 300 jobs and producing components for energy storage systems. The company hopes to employ over 440 jobs in the coming years.

item.title: Purdue’s Braden Smith records 1,000th career assist
item.description: Braden Smith became the fifth player in Division 1 men's college basketball history to reach 1,000 career assists.

item.title: Weather service confirms 3rd Indiana tornado in February storms
item.description: The National Weather Service has confirmed a third tornado from storms that moved across Indiana on Feb. 19, 2026. No injuries or property damage was reported in the Decatur County tornado.

item.title: Book tour of former Vice President Kamala Harris stops in Indianapolis
item.description: As part of a tour, former Vice President Kamala Harris visited Indianapolis on Feb. 26, 2026, to share reflections from the 2024 presidential campaign and promote her book "107 Days."

item.title: Kick, snap and dash during fan event at NFL combine in Indianapolis
item.description: The 40th NFL scouting combine is happening at Lucas Oil Stadium, with 319 football prospects trying out for NFL teams as fans of all ages participate in interactive exercises and photo opportunities with giant helmets from all 32 teams. Find out how to register before you go.

item.title: Gov. Braun signs measure to finance, build Chicago Bears stadium in Indiana
item.description: Indiana Gov. Mike Braun signed a bill to establish a northwest Indiana stadium authority, which could potentially lead to the relocation of the Chicago Bears to Hammond, Indiana.
